title: Stopped working and quietness comments
summary: This topic combines brief positive remarks about the car being fantastic or quiet with negative reports of systems, especially audio functions, stopping working.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car overall or note quiet operation.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe features or systems stopping working, including broad functionality failures and stereo playback or bass cutting out.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are too brief to identify a clear aspect beyond incomplete aside-style phrasing.

limitations: This cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including overall praise, quietness, broad functionality failure, and stereo-specific issues.
Several fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits precise interpretation of the underlying customer concern.
The examples are few and stratified, so they should not be treated as representative of the full model population.
